text: New: Mk 24 (AR), RSPR (SMG), Z84M (LMG), ELR-40 (sniper). Mk 24, RSPR, Z84M: tier 11 of a themed path; ELR-40 free at Recruit tier 5.
SVDM & M39 EMR: slower recoil recovery (exponent 0.75→1.1); SVDM recoil direction 4°→20° – rapid fire is punished.
Controller: recoil compensation reduced from 11% to 5%.
SU-230 LPVO no longer wrongly reduces visual recoil (M433, GRT-BC, M417 A2).
REDSEC: KTS100 MK8, SCW-10, SVDM, SG 553R, KV9 adjusted; several calibers need one more hit vs. armor.
Season 4 catch-up challenges added for BROD 3, Interdictor and VSSM.
